page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core, and integrates a single NVIDIA Pascal P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. It does not include local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage options, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that this instance has notable performance limitations in CPU-bound and memory-bound tasks. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance falls in the bottom 10%, while multi-core performance and Passmark CPU extended instructions rank in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks is also weak, registering at 37.18 GB/sec for read and 25.34 GB/sec for write operations. However, cached small-block read-only memory bandwidth performs at an average level of 340.09 GB/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c8g1.2xlarge offers an entry-level GPU hardware profile suitable for workloads that require hardware acceleration but do not demand high-performance modern CPU compute or massive memory throughput. Appropriate workloads include legacy GPU-accelerated applications, basic video transcoding, low-density inference tasks, and lightweight CUDA development or testing environments.
